camera.method: phase correlation of rock region vs frame 0, all 40 frames

horizon.note: sea/sky boundary (far sea horizon); right side lower -> slight camera roll ~1.4 deg; camera looks roughly level (horizon at ~0.82 of image height means camera pitched slightly up or horizon below centre)

objects.name: airplane
objects.desc: white twin-engine business/regional jet (T-tail, rear-mounted engines, landing gear down), only moving object; seen side-on, flies right-to-left across the upper sky
objects.visible_frames: 0-38 (enters at right edge frame 0, fully in frame 7-30, exits left edge, gone at 39)
objects.reference_point: use cx_bbox,cy_bbox (mask bbox centre) or cx_centroid,cy_centroid as origin proxy; only frames 7-30 are uncut

apparent_size_px.note: nose-to-tail mask length shrinks ~501->425 px over frames 7-30 (ratio ~0.85): plane recedes from camera; part of early length is motion blur (~60 px/frame displacement)

objects.name: airplane_shadow
objects.desc: dark blurry shadow of the plane on the sea, lower right, moves right-to-left

objects.name: rock_island
objects.desc: tall grey rock sea-stack covered with green trees/shrubs, centre-left; with a lower tree-covered ledge on its left

extents_px_frame16.note: manual reading from grid image frames/f16.png, +-10 px

objects.name: sandbar_beach
objects.desc: pale pink-white sand spit around the rock base, extends to bottom edge and to the right

extents_px.note: approx; cut by bottom edge; right tip ~x1300

objects.name: sea
objects.desc: turquoise sea with small whitecaps, animated waves (not an object that translates)

objects.name: sky
objects.desc: blue sky, hazy near horizon, no clouds/birds

events.event: plane nose enters at right edge
plane fully inside frame (tail fin in)
plane last visible (tail at left edge)
plane motion: steady leftward and slightly downward in image throughout; no direction change, no contact/impact
